headlines.title: Major U.S. Oil Port Selected for Nuclear Power Project
headlines.summary: The port of Corpus Christi has become one of two ports selected for a project aimed at integrating small modular reactors in a bid to expand the use of nuclear power in more industries—and propel SMR technology forward. Small modular reactors are all the rage, at least on paper.
